description: Compare costs for multiple LLM models

country.description: Optional ISO-3166 alpha-2 country whose currency to use (e.g. DE -> EUR, IN -> INR). A country whose currency is unsupported yields USD with fallback_to_usd=true.

currency.description: Optional ISO-4217 code to convert prices into, alongside the canonical USD figures. Beats country. Unsupported codes return success=false listing the supported set.

model_names.description: List of model names to compare

name: compare_costs
